definitions: An individual's subjective assessment of their own abilities or competence in a particular area, which may or may not align with their actual skill level.
The level of proficiency or expertise that someone believes they possess, often influencing their confidence and behavior.
examples: His perceived skill level was much higher than his actual performance.
Despite her high perceived skill level, she struggled with the task.
The coach aimed to boost the team's perceived skill level through positive reinforcement.
